summary: BE - Invite Friends - Refer and Earn
description: Backend referral attribution must reconcile referral events into per-referrer progress used by the hard-referral lock state.
acceptance_criteria: Only known referral codes can move progress.
The output must be deterministic for repeated verifier runs.

summary: [RF-020] Referral counted on existing user sign-in via link
description: Existing users who sign in through a friend's referral link are still successful referrals.
acceptance_criteria: Treat eventType=signin as eligible referral activity.
Do not restrict successful referrals to first-time signup events only.

summary: [RF-022] Referee from two referrers credits both
description: The same referee can legitimately arrive through two different friends' links during the rollout.
acceptance_criteria: Deduplicate only the same referrer/referee pair.
Do not use a global referred-user set that blocks credit for a different referrer.

summary: [RF-023] Self-referral on same device not counted
description: A referrer cannot earn progress by using their own referral code.
acceptance_criteria: Ignore an event when referredUserId is the same as the referrer's userId.
The self-referral check applies before incrementing referralCount.

summary: [RF-024] Self-referral on different device not counted
description: Self-referral is invalid even when it appears as a normal event from another device/session.
acceptance_criteria: The same user-id comparison blocks self-referral across devices.
Do not rely on device metadata to decide self-referral validity.
